about: The lightweight budgets' baselines (plan section 11): every accepted size of Featherweight.exe and the portable zip per compiler, and every accepted set of timings per computer, each with why. scripts\budgets.ps1 checks a build against the last entries and adds new ones with -Record; see tests\budgets\README.md.

sizes.reason: 0.9.4 as released, built by scripts\release.ps1: where the ledger starts.

D0 host and foundations: Direct3D 11 swap chain, the Painter and vector printing, the new widgets with UI Automation, side panel, status bar, command search, start screen and fwpkg. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Timings 19-37 % faster than 0.9.4, memory within 3 %.

D1: the read-only Word document tab: the fwdoc model and .docx reader, fwtext line layout and hyphenation patterns, fwdraw DrawingML/VML pictures, pagination, and DocView with find, selection, comments, tracked changes, links and vector printing. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Exe 2.64 MB (budget 4 MB). A 300-page .docx is fully paginated in under 0.8 s at 61 MB; PDF timings unchanged.

D1 exit check (non-layout criteria): the Word document viewer as merged in d0/host c71b693, plus the model fixes fuzzing found. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Exe 2.77 MB (budget 4 MB). Timings kept from the aaf2a08 entry: re-measured on 2026-11-05 at 12:40 while other sessions loaded the PC (unchanged PDF scenarios 25-60 % slower too). Absolute D1 budgets met even then: 300-page .docx paginated in 0.88 s (budget 3 s), 61 MB.

D1 final: the pagination merged in d0/host 6f495ca (91.7 % of page counts, 95.2 % of lines match Word), with the model fixes from fuzzing. Shipped build. Exe 2.82 MB (budget 4 MB). 300-page .docx paginated in 0.80 s, 61 MB, idle 0, measured under load from other sessions; timings kept from the aaf2a08 entry.

D2 formatting (claude/d2-format, with claude/d2-edit 7fa93e2 merged): character and paragraph formatting, styles, lists, the format painter, Insert date and time, the toolbar's formatting groups and Word's keys (fwdoc edit/Format, Styles, Lists, TreeEdit; word/DocFormat), plus d2-edit's editor, typing, find and replace, formatted copy and paste (RTF and HTML) and relayout after edits. Shipped build. Exe 3.20 MB (budget 4 MB). Formatting on a 278-page document: median 12 ms, worst 24 ms (fwtool typing). Timings not re-recorded: measured under load from other sessions (PDF scenarios, untouched, 25-40 % slower too); side by side with claude/d2-proof's build under the same load, launch memory and times match.

timings.reason: 0.9.4 as released (scripts\release.ps1's build), the development PC's starting point. D0 must be no slower and use no more memory (plan section 11).

D1: the read-only Word document tab: the fwdoc model and .docx reader, fwtext line layout and hyphenation patterns, fwdraw DrawingML/VML pictures, pagination, and DocView with find, selection, comments, tracked changes, links and vector printing. Shipped build (FW_TEST_SCREENS=OFF). Exe 2.64 MB (budget 4 MB). A 300-page .docx is fully paginated in under 0.8 s at 61 MB; PDF timings unchanged.

typing.reason: D2: incremental relayout after edits (Layout::Edited, page checkpoints, paragraph line cache). Measured with fwtool bench --typing on the Release build: keystroke to the page painted again on the GPU, at the start, middle and end of the 300-page document.

D2: typing in a table lays out only the rows it changed, and cells, notes and headers keep the lines of paragraphs laid out before. A fourth place types in the last table cell on the middle page. In the UN financial report (353 pages, one table of 225 rows), a keystroke in that table takes 2.5 ms, down from 48.
